notes: 0.4.2：地址、文档与发行包的修正。官方脚本清单和更新检查的 Gitee 默认地址改为直连 CDN，旧地址会跳转到带时效签名的地址，过期即打不开；随包《开发指南》重新对齐脚本仓库真源，副本里指向仓库 README／LICENSE 的链接改成绝对地址；维护者的待办文档不再随包发行；构建期文档落盘改为每次构建都跑，避免只改文档时把上一版文档打进发行包。
notes_en: 0.4.2: Address, documentation and package fixes. The Gitee defaults for the official script catalog and the update check now hit the CDN directly, since the old form redirected to a time-limited signed URL that eventually stopped working. The bundled script dev guide is resynced with the script repository (and its README/LICENSE links made absolute, they pointed at files missing from docs), the maintainer to-do list no longer ships in the package, and the build now stages the shipped docs on every build so a docs-only change can no longer ship the previous copy.
